options.reason: The table is a TCGA tumour expression matrix (981 rows) with one categorical clinical/molecular label, PAM50, in five classes; the evident aim is supervised multiclass prediction of intrinsic subtype from the ~17.8k numeric gene-expression features, trained/selected on TCGA and then applied once to the external CPTAC cohort (which lacks Normal-like). sample_id is a row key only and must be excluded from features; no column is a recoding of the target.
options.title: multiclass
